blockingFindings.title: Missing validatingTestResult binding mismatch coverage
blockingFindings.rationale: This leaves a mandatory evidence-binding requirement without regression coverage and permits a static anti-pattern where production behavior can ignore nested validation-result identity binding.
blockingFindings.issue: R2/R3 require evidence.validatingTestResult to match the current finding and evaluated target state, but the tests only reject a failing status. They do not cover a passing validatingTestResult with mismatched findingFingerprint or reviewedTree, so an implementation that checks only status: "pass" would still pass.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add spec-local rejection cases for validatingTestResult.findingFingerprint mismatch and validatingTestResult.reviewedTree mismatch while the top-level evidence fingerprint/tree still match.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: This leaves a mandatory evidence-binding requirement without regression coverage and permits a static anti-pattern where production behavior can ignore nested validation-result identity binding.

blockingFindings.title: Missing explicit allow decision coverage
blockingFindings.rationale: The coverage artifact marks R2 covered, but one of its explicit acceptance alternatives has no corresponding executable test coverage.
blockingFindings.issue: R2 allows mandatory findings to pass without repair evidence when an existing explicit allow/defer decision applies, but the tests only cover a deferred disposition and not an explicit allow decision.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local test for the explicit allow decision path without repair evidence.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The coverage artifact marks R2 covered, but one of its explicit acceptance alternatives has no corresponding executable test coverage.
